An important reminder about radio checks
It is for travelers

Travelers with animals must confirm their arrangements before departure and keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk informed of any change in condition, carrier, or routing. Please read the guidance below and bring any concern to staff as soon as you notice it.

Animal travel notice

Please arrive prepared with the documents and equipment required for your journey. Staff will review each case, record service changes in the desk ledger, and adjust handling where needed so the animal remains safe and settled. If a traveler is worried, the supervisor will listen carefully and help select the right support for the trip.

Care plans should reflect the species, temperament, and comfort needs of the animal, including rest, water, and quiet handling. A calm carrier, clear labeling, and steady communication help reduce delay at the terminal and support a smoother transfer to the aircraft. If a traveler is bringing a pet such as Teddy, the desk should be told early so the team can prepare the right handling notes.

Aurelia Skyways asks all travelers to follow desk guidance closely and to check for any update before departure. For final support, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
